description: Implement User Sessions & Devices, Security Logs, User Warnings & Suspensions, AI Moderation, Device Fingerprinting, Push Notifications (FCM setup), Deep Linking, and App branding (splash/icon config).
steps: 1. Create lib/features/sessions/ with: providers/sessions_provider.dart (fetch from user_sessions and user_devices tables), screens/sessions_screen.dart (show active login sessions with device name, location, last_active; logout from other devices button). user_sessions: id, user_id, device_id, ip_address, user_agent, is_active, created_at, last_active_at. user_devices: id, user_id, device_name, device_type, os_version, app_version, fcm_token, created_at.

2. Create lib/features/security/ with: providers/security_provider.dart (fetch from security_logs table), screens/security_logs_screen.dart (login history with device/IP/location, suspicious activity alerts with colored badges). security_logs: id, user_id, event_type, ip_address, device_info, location, is_suspicious, created_at.

3. Create lib/features/warnings/ with: providers/warnings_provider.dart (fetch user_warnings and user_suspensions), screens/warnings_screen.dart (show warnings list with severity, appeal button). user_warnings: id, user_id, reason, severity (low/medium/high), issued_by, created_at. user_suspensions: id, user_id, reason, suspended_by, starts_at, ends_at, is_active, appeal_text, appeal_status.

4. Create lib/features/moderation/ with: providers/moderation_provider.dart (for admin: fetch ai_moderation_logs and moderation_queue), screens/moderation_screen.dart (admin: view flagged content, approve/reject from queue). ai_moderation_logs: id, content_id, content_type, flagged_reason, confidence_score, action_taken, reviewed_by, created_at. moderation_queue: id, content_id, content_type, reported_by, reason, status (pending/approved/rejected), reviewed_by, created_at.

5. Create lib/features/device_fingerprint/ with: providers/device_fingerprint_provider.dart (store device info on login to device_fingerprints table). device_fingerprints: id, user_id, fingerprint_hash, device_info (jsonb), ip_address, is_trusted, first_seen_at, last_seen_at. Integrate into login flow (after successful auth, record device fingerprint).

6. Create lib/features/notifications/providers/push_notification_provider.dart (FCM token registration placeholder - save token to user_devices table, handle incoming notification display). Note: actual Firebase init requires firebase_messaging package which is not in pubspec, so create the provider structure that would work once the package is added. For now, use a placeholder that stores tokens via the existing notification system.

7. Update lib/core/router/app_router.dart to support deep linking: handle URIs like /campaign/{id} and /profile/{handle}. Add a redirect handler that maps deep link paths to existing routes. The campaign detail route already exists at /campaigns/:id. Add a /profile/:handle route that looks up user by handle.
8. Create lib/features/profile/screens/public_profile_screen.dart (view another user profile by handle - fetch from users table by handle, show public info).

9. Update android/app/src/main/res/ for proper app icon configuration: create an adaptive icon configuration file. Create assets for splash screen branding (update the existing splash_screen.dart to show Rexo logo properly with animation).
10. Add routes: /sessions, /security-logs, /warnings, /moderation (admin only). Update profile menu to include Sessions and Security.
11. Ensure device fingerprint recording is called after login in auth_provider.dart (add a post-login hook that saves device info).
acceptance_criteria: User Sessions screen shows active sessions with logout-from-other-devices
Security Logs show login history with device/location info
Warnings screen shows user warnings with appeal system
Moderation screen (admin) shows flagged content queue
Device fingerprinting saves device info on login
Push notification provider structure exists for FCM token management
Public profile screen shows user info by handle
Splash screen shows Rexo branding with animation
flutter analyze passes on all new files
verification: Read all new files and verify proper Dart syntax
Verify routes and deep linking configuration
Verify auth_provider.dart integration for device fingerprinting
findings: All 11 feature modules/updates completed. Created sessions (with terminate functionality), security logs (with filter chips), warnings (with appeal bottom sheet), moderation (admin-only with queue and AI logs tabs), device fingerprint (integrated into auth flow), push notification provider (FCM placeholder), public profile screen (by handle), and updated splash with flutter_animate. Auth provider now accepts Ref to call device fingerprint after login. Router has 6 new routes (sessions, security-logs, warnings, moderation, profile/:handle). Profile screen has 2 new menu items (Sessions & Devices, Security). Changed some Iconsax icons to confirmed-existing alternatives (cpu -> chart_2, danger -> warning_2, user_remove -> user, tablet -> mobile, devices -> mobile, monitor_mobbile -> monitor). ShimmerLoading does not accept count parameter - used height-only. Network blocked so no flutter analyze run - manual code review performed.
